scope: Descriptive audit of existing V2 pilot, not a causal attribution or new experiment
findings: On has two command executions versus three off, so more shell commands do not explain the total regression.
On re-inspects raw facts, including facts present in the packet; the packet does not eliminate ordinary source checking.
On reports a memory-helper permission error without a corresponding command_execution item in this public event trace; whether unexposed runtime work explains it is unverified.
Reasoning output and extra messages increase, but this single trace pair cannot establish the cause or generalize a model-specific policy.
next_gate: Prospective efficient ordinary-copy versus renderer-assisted tasks; preserve complete source and output verification, record all native and renderer costs.
